brief.t: Raanan Rosenbaum call is at 9:30 AM Eastern today. Prepare and attend; it is the only hard-time commitment in Sam’s first lane.
Ashley at Earth and Ash sent Miron Glass bottle and closure codes for all three products and is ready to pay when invoiced. Send the accurate invoice now; Brian Morgan is away until next week.
Victor Armendarez is an 88-percent-close, two-SKU opportunity at 2,000 units each. Finish verified pricing for the Curl Defining Cream and Edge Gel and send it today.
Diana at ELOIRE was promised her 500- and 1,000-unit dry-shampoo reorder pricing and packaging notes by end of day today. Deliver the quote as committed.
Ben Kar’s Tavro deal is 90 percent close and roughly 30,000 units, but the proposal or post-call recap remains overdue. Send it today after the immediate invoices and quotes.

UnShrink It Q-0047 is still Incomplete—Needs Inputs. The $204.98-per-1,000 raw-material reference is not a customer-ready quote; quantity, packaging, labor, overhead, and approved margin remain required.
Ashley invoice and ALOETALLOW’s reorder meeting are the first WhatsApp revenue triage. Ads spent $23.62 yesterday under cap; tracking is live, but paid attribution is not established.

next: Prepare for and attend Raanan’s 9:30 AM ET call
Send Ashley / Earth and Ash the verified invoice
Finish and send Victor pricing for both 2,000-unit SKUs
Send Diana’s ELOIRE reorder quote and packaging notes, then Tavro proposal/recap

kb.a: Victor Armendarez / HT Products is 88% close, NDA signed, for 2,000 units each of Curl Defining Cream and Edge Gel in six-ounce jars. He checked back in July 21; PLL owes verified pricing on both turnkey SKUs today. Do not state a price or production date until full costing is verified.

Ben Kar of Tavro is 90% close for about 30,000 units of custom tallow and argan-oil skincare. No confirmed proposal or post-call recap has been delivered since the June 30 call. Sam should send it today after the immediate Ashley, Victor, and Diana revenue tasks.

A six thousand three hundred fourteen dollar eighty-eight cent ACH deposit from Shopify landed in Huntington account CK4274 at three thirty-eight this morning, July twenty-first. Account balance is now forty-one thousand two hundred seventy-five dollars and thirty-three cents. CRM deposits collected updated to fifty-seven thousand four hundred fifty-four dollars and ninety-nine cents.

Lainey Henican's Tallow Cream scent is settled on Honeysuckle fragrance — Ronald recommended it and Lainey approved on July twentieth. However, Lainey has now pivoted her branding from the magnolia flower to a lantern as the primary emblem, with delicate flowers surrounding it. The most recent exchange on July twentieth confirmed this direction. Laura must acknowledge the brand revision and move forward. The R&D cost question is also overdue in the CRM.

Sam selected fifty thousand dollar actual cash value coverage at four hundred dollars for the Michigan Office Movers move. Lori from Michigan Office Movers confirmed on July twentieth. The two thousand seven hundred fifty dollar deposit paperwork is still pending Sam's signature and submission. The move date remains around the twenty-eighth.

Lynn Corporate Park's monthly tenant statement arrived July twentieth from Catalyst Management. Operating expenses changed effective January first twenty twenty-six; Sam must review the new total and remit payment. No amount was specified in the email body — the amount is in the attached statement.

STRUCK product preservative challenge test came back PASS. Sam forwarded the PET results from Mark to Ronald and Evelyn on July twentieth for their records. No further action needed from Sam on this item.

Elior dry shampoo quote for five hundred and a thousand units is overdue in the CRM since July fourteenth. Still needs Ronald's BOM, product and packaging clarification, and margin at sixty-five or seventy-five percent. Aerosol matters because it triggers H occupancy and mandatory sprinklers at the new facility.

James Bailey's twelve-ounce Menthol Infused Shampoo production is active in the CRM with deposit received status, total project value eight thousand seven hundred forty dollars. A logo-branded bottle for marketing was requested. Sam must assign the sample production and confirm a ship date.

The ConvertFlow lead capture webhook is fixed and live as of July sixteenth. Leads now flow to the agent and route into Sam's Outlook. First real lead is Hariett at HBI Salon, a custom hair loss shampoo, masque and serum, five hundred to a thousand units. About one hundred five contacts in ConvertFlow await Sam's go-ahead to sort real buyers from junk.

ISO 22716 GMP certification project was signed July sixteenth at fourteen thousand seven hundred dollars. Aidan negotiated and closed it. GMP certification path is officially in motion for the new facility.

Coast Southwest proforma invoice PO 2026-0004 remains unpaid as of July twenty-first. No new email movement found. Jessica Gutierrez says raw materials ship on receipt of funds. Sam needs to release payment or provide a hold reason.
Gusto payroll is no longer an overdue action. ACH withdrawals posted July 23 morning: $2,027.31 GUSTO NET and $697.22 GUSTO TAX. Treat payroll as posted, absent contrary evidence.

Nadia Dupuis at Oreka Skincare sent a PDF of proposed Canadian label changes on July sixteenth and asked for review. Laura replied she is working on the cream jar. Nadia thanked her. Laura must return the cream jar update and review the label changes today.

Raanan Rosenbaum of Raanan Media has a 30-minute call with Sam at 9:30 AM Eastern on Thursday, July 23. This is Sam’s hard-time first priority for the day; prepare and attend before revenue follow-up work.

Hawke Media sent an onboarding survey email on July twentieth asking about Sam's onboarding team experience. Desiree Moore has checked in twice for Ephix kickoff status. Provide a one-line status update so a reply can go out before the account cools further.

New Shopify lead from July twentieth: Oussama Salmi, afghani oil haircare brand selling in Saudi Arabia and Europe, launching in the US. Wants to match formula, five hundred to a thousand units, packaging help, starting now. Email osalmi890@gmail.com, phone plus one seven zero seven seven three one six three seven nine.

Anfal Mohammed sent repeated Shopify Inbox messages July nineteenth seeking per-unit serum or cream pricing above and below one hundred units. Reply with verified pricing only, after confirming exact product, size and quantity.

Jonathan Caesar at Ethnic Gals asked July thirteenth for an inventory spec sheet and pickup count. Aidan should call Jonathan directly and the warehouse should send a written count and pickup status today.

CRM Development / Issues remains unresolved. Laura’s latest July 22 10:47 AM report: customer-page task creation lacks an Assign To team-member dropdown. CRM Developer owns a fix and ready-for-verification update; do not claim it is resolved or assign it to Sam.

True Revival: client revised to a 200 mL dark-green, light-blocking, shower-safe jar with gold branding. Drake accepts 500 or 1,000 jar MOQ. Laura is sourcing lower-MOQ custom or stock options with domestic decoration.

Kendall sent an order-today request on July 21 for pheromone-infused body butter. Six explicit deliverables required before close of business: one, pheromone addition to base formula must be confirmed; two, match five custom scent profiles from breakdowns Kendall will send; three, provide a truthful written statement of PLL’s current FDA-registration status; four, verify whether six dollars per unit at two hundred fifty units still stands; five, provide jar dimensions for label artwork; six, send final invoice to pay today. Volume: two hundred fifty units, four-ounce jars, customer-supplied labels, one-week turnaround that must be re-verified before commitment. This is the highest-priority revenue action for July 22; no term is confirmed until verified.

UnShrink It Q-0047 remains Incomplete - Needs Inputs with a $0 quote price. CRM notes only a $204.98 raw-material reference per 1,000-unit batch, about $0.2050 per unit. Order quantity, packaging, fill labor, overhead, and approved margin are missing; it is not customer-ready and must not be sent.

Kenna meeting executed July twenty-first. Outcome: body wash, shampoo, and conditioner require viscosity and performance revisions. Aaron owns Terra Lotus epic shampoo revision. PLL must prepare small-batch viscosity and appearance photos for all three products and send to Kenna via WhatsApp. Seven total action items from the meeting report; only two are currently visible to the command center as of July twenty-second morning. Photos are the immediate blocker to progression.

Ads performance July twenty-first: total spend twenty-six dollars sixty-two cents, ninety-four impressions, twelve clicks, twelve point eight percent CTR, two dollars twenty-two CPC. Spend is under the thirty dollar daily hard cap. Trailing seven days (July fourteen to twenty): thirty-one dollars seventy-two cents, one hundred twenty-two impressions, sixteen clicks. Leads remain unattributed because lead tracking approval is pending. Do not claim booked-call attribution until tracking is approved and verified.

WhatsApp showed twenty-two unread client threads on July twenty-second morning. Priority threads include HALENE asking for a timeline, MEN STUFF, one Time Bargain, BEEF BUM, Kora James, PHYLARA, ASSEA, and other current customers. Triage by customer risk and revenue; do not assume the displayed unread count equals unanswered messages from the client.

Tavro proposal has not been sent to Ben Kar since the June thirtieth call. Deal status: ninety percent close, approximately thirty thousand units custom tallow and argan oil skincare. This is the single largest deal by volume on the board. One proposal document stands between current status and signed order. Sam sends today.

Gusto payroll for the June twenty-ninth through July twelfth pay period was due July seventeenth. Payroll remains overdue as of July twenty-second morning. CEO immediate action required. No completion confirmation found in email or CRM as of July twenty-second.

Coast Southwest proforma invoice PO two zero two six zero zero zero four remains unpaid as of July twenty-second. Jessica Gutierrez has stated that raw materials will ship on receipt of funds. Sam must either release payment today or provide a documented hold reason.

HALENE’s latest visible WhatsApp message is “Anytime,” and the prior timeline concern appears answered sufficiently. Keep the project monitored, but prioritize active purchase and reorder requests such as Ashley and ALOETALLOW unless HALENE sends a new blocker.

The Emanay Personal Care Ventures mutual agreement has been redrafted at twenty percent and professionally branded with the authentic PLL logo. It remains a review draft only; it has not been sent or signed. Do not confuse it with the older BrandHaus/Alex task.

Nikkie sent Ashley a brand-development inquiry response on July twenty-first at ten twenty-eight PM Eastern and copied Sam. Monitor for Ashley’s reply and qualify product, quantity, timeline, budget, and manufacturing fit before committing pricing.

Exactly seven approved net-new ad groups remain live. July 22 spend was $23.62 for 78 impressions and 10 clicks, under the $30/day cap. GCLID, UTM, and hidden-source tracking are live and verified, but neither the inquiry nor the Kora James close should be claimed as paid-attributable.

Ashley at Earth and Ash supplied Miron Glass bottle and closure item codes for three products and says she is ready to pay once she receives an invoice. Brian Morgan is away until next week. Validate the line items and send the invoice today; this is the first active revenue action after Sam’s 9:30 AM Raanan call.

Diana Aviles of ELOIRE is a returning dry-shampoo customer seeking a reorder in 500- and 1,000-unit quantities using the prior formula and packaging. PLL committed to send final pricing and first-run packaging notes by end of day July 23. Deliver both price tiers and notes today.

Kyle at ALOETALLOW says they need to reorder soon and requested a meeting. This is an active current-customer revenue request; offer times and establish reorder quantity and timing before broad WhatsApp cleanup.
ANFALINE formally declined on price as of July 22 and is closed lost. Do not continue active sales follow-up; retain only for future re-engagement if the customer initiates it.

Yanay at Luxivelle submitted a new haircare website lead July 22 night, with form preview suggesting 500–1,000 units. Email Agent owns qualification of product scope, quantity, packaging, timeline, budget, and manufacturing fit.

Jabari / Work 4 Wealth has a discovery call booked Friday, July 24 at 10:00 AM ET. The initial scope is about 300 total units across three products: barrier cream, rich body butter, and botanical serum or massage oil. Prepare to confirm volume, product path, packaging, and fit.
Luke / Mothered requests an exact remaining-bottle count from a 200-bottle batch and clarification on the 60 bottles received. Operations must verify inventory and shipment records before responding.
